attributes.name: Armor of the Pious
attributes.powers:
When you play a blessing that has the Iomedae trait, reveal this card to allow a character at your location to recharge a random card from his discard pile.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 3.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with heavy armors, bury it instead.

If proficient with heavy armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.

corrections.corrected_text: On the armor Armor of the Pious, add the Iomedae trait.
corrections.issue: Should Armor of the Pious have the Iomedae trait?
